newsitem.title: estonia: MARKET TRADE SHARPLY HIGHER, HANSA, HOIU LEAD.
newsitem.headline: MARKET TRADE SHARPLY HIGHER, HANSA, HOIU LEAD.

text.p: *Trade on the Estonian bourse was 114.6 million kroons of shares including 99.3 million kroons of shares on the official list.
*Talse gained 2.02 percent to close on a new high of 236.11
* Hansapank and Hoiupank were the most active stocks
* Hansapank turns over 28.1 million kroons of shares
